entries.label: Wilshire lobby
entries.note: On Wilshire: the lobby and the café share one entrance. Facial-recognition turnstiles past the desk.

entries.label: Garage ramp
entries.note: A podium garage with plate readers at the gate; residents and tenants share it after 7 pm.

entries.label: Loading dock
entries.note: Off the rear alley: one bay with a roll-up door on a timed lock, open 7 am to 3 pm.

entries.label: Bike room door
entries.note: A side door to the bike room. Badge only, and a camera over the frame.

entries.label: Roof deck
entries.note: The tenant roof deck. Its door to the lift lobby locks at 10 pm.
